hints.text: Pull out what every term shares. What divides both $5x$ and $10$?
The GCF is $5$. Write $5x + 10 = 5(\;? + ?\;)$ and fill the blanks.

explanation: Both terms share a factor of $5$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Un-multiply it
steps: Factoring runs distribution backwards: you know the spread-out answer, find what was multiplied.

alternativeExplanations.title: Area model backwards
steps: Picture a rectangle of area 5x + 10 with one side 5.
Split the area into 5x and 10; the other side must be x and 2.
